sinopsis.es: Peter Frampton revisita 50 años de carrera, desde The Herd y Humble Pie hasta el estrellato en estadios y de regreso. Una retrospectiva construida con sus propias palabras.
sinopsis.en: Peter Frampton revisits 50 years of a career — from The Herd and Humble Pie to stadium stardom and back. A retrospective built from his own words, told by his longtime bandleader.
